generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investorId ?investorName
WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:category ?cat .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?cat)) = "long-term") .
  ?inv wm:hasInvestmentGoal ?goal .
  ?goal a wm:InvestmentGoal .
  ?goal wm:hasInvestmentGoalType ?goalType .
  ?goalType rdfs:label ?typeLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?typeLabel)), "retirement planning")) .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorId ?investorId . }
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }
}

PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?investor ?investorLabel
WHERE {
  ?investor a wm:Investor .
  {
    ?investor wm:timeHorizon ?thLit .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?thLit)), "long"))
  } UNION {
    ?investor wm:hasTimeHorizon ?thObj .
    ?thObj rdfs:label ?thLabel .
    FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?thLabel)), "long"))
  }
  ?investor ?rel ?goal .
  ?goal a wm:InvestmentGoal .
  ?goal rdfs:label ?goalLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?goalLabel)), "retirement planning"))
  OPTIONAL { ?investor rdfs:label ?investorLabel . }
}
